# ffmpeg

This mod adds ffmpeg to lazylibrarian, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `lazylibrarian` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:lazylibrarian-ffmpeg
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:lazylibrarian-ffmpeg|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

To enable it you can set the ffmpeg path under Settings > Processing > External Programs to `ffmpeg` in the LazyLibrarian Web UI.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/lazylibrarian-ffmpeg/
